# moodycamel concurrentqueue

Version: `v1.0.5`

Tag commit: `9afb99746f0f5fc94ac8aef737053ae0481ba8d1`

Source: <https://github.com/cameron314/concurrentqueue>

The vendored files are:

- `blockingconcurrentqueue.h`
- `concurrentqueue.h`
- `lightweightsemaphore.h`
